collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A builder's favorite adze has gone missing, and someone mutters that the newcomer was seen near the workshop.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1)'s favorite adze has gone missing, and someone mutters that the newcomer was seen near the workshop.

choices.label: Ask the Newcomer Directly and Kindly.
Speak to the One Who Muttered.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The adze turns up under a pile of shavings.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The adze is never found, but no one is blamed.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The newcomer had borrowed it, meaning to ask, and returns it immediately.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The newcomer knows nothing about it and is hurt by the suspicion, and the builder apologizes.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The adze is found in a basket of tools.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They admit they had no real reason for the suspicion.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They insist on their view, and the builder decides not to follow it.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: The search finds three other tools missing for months but no adze.

c2__text.name: Outcome C2
c2__text.text: The search finds three other tools missing for months but no adze.
